timing: Supplemental reconstruction from immutable entrypoint client-start log (one-second resolution) and canonical client completion. Native rolling-probe throughput not used.
cost: Slurm allocated GPU count times parent array-task elapsed seconds / 3600; includes startup and shutdown.
validation: Draft 2020-12 schema validity, JSON parsing and conformance; schema wrapper unwrapped when present.
limitations: Small single trials, no steady-state window isolation or confidence intervals. No production-scale generation or interrupted-generation resume test. Cause of observed cross-topology plateau not isolated.
projection_note: Illustrative one-million-valid-record projection uses selected measured valid/client-second rate, allocation-start-to-client-start overhead (262s), rounded-up 4s shutdown allowance, 4h allocation budget, rounded-up whole allocations; no queue/failure/variability allowance. Not executed at production scale.
